contract.name: Narration
contract.description: Contract for resolving and controlling narration associated with educational book pages.

capability.name: Narration
capability.responsibility: Provide narration resolution and playback control through a stable narration identifier.

rules: Narration is identified by a stable narration identifier.
The narration identifier is independent of the narration provider.
Narration does not expose provider-specific implementation details.
Narration does not depend on a specific technology or provider.
Only the Narration capability controls narration playback state.
A narration resource may be resolved from a stable narration identifier.
The narration state must be reported through the Narration contract.
The Narration capability exposes WHAT narration operation is requested, not HOW playback is implemented.

errors.NARRATION_NOT_FOUND: The requested narration identifier does not exist.
errors.NARRATION_NOT_RESOLVED: The narration resource could not be resolved.
errors.PLAYBACK_ERROR: The narration could not be played.
errors.PAUSE_ERROR: The narration could not be paused.
errors.STOP_ERROR: The narration could not be stopped.
